CapabilityEffects.title: CapabilityEffects

CapabilityLimits.description:
Bounds enforced when this capability runs. All optional — unset means unbounded.

HF-035 adds the size/record-count/cost triad alongside the pre-existing
``timeout_seconds`` (duration): together these are the four retention/cost
dimensions `f.hermes_flow.policies.evaluator.evaluate_policy` can deny a
request for, the same way it already denies on `max_concurrency`/
`rate_limit_per_minute`. Declaring a limit here does not itself measure or
estimate anything — evaluation only compares whatever the caller reports it
expects (``PolicyContext.requested_*``) against the declared bound.

max_cost_usd.description: Largest estimated model/inference cost, in USD, one invocation may incur. See f.libraries.retention.models.estimate_cost_usd for the caller-side estimate this is compared against.
max_cost_usd.title: Max Cost Usd

max_record_count.description: Largest number of records (rows, items, documents) one invocation may produce or process, e.g. a dataset extraction's row count.
max_record_count.title: Max Record Count

max_response_bytes.description: Largest response/output size this capability may return, in bytes.
max_response_bytes.title: Max Response Bytes
